items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Clema Turbillon, Earl Barnes, Walter Daniel, Bob Ogden. I forgot who played bass. The music for the date? Yeah. Clema Turbillon.

ctx.x: Now, who was recording for Deluxe, Deluxe Records? Yeah, Deluxe. And do you remember who was on that session? Who would have?

Clema Turbillon, Earl Barnes, Walter Daniel, Bob Ogden. I forgot who played bass. The music for the date? Yeah. Clema Turbillon. And most of the stuff was done at the studio. Roy didn't have enough songs to sing, so he was at the studio. Roy had to sing to remember to sing to remember to sing to remember to sing to remember to Roy didn't have enough songs to sing, so he was at that studio, and he would, he was in the back of the room, he was talking, he was writing out some lyrics, he said, well I got one now. So…
Oh yeah. Yeah, definitely. So you didn't have, did you have any input into the arrangement, or? I took a solo on this Mighty Mighty Man.
